_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Security Verification Plan and Procedures
summary: The Security Verification Plan and Procedures describes tests verifying that cryptographic principles and protective alarms in equipment agree with contract requirements, covering Information Assurance circuitry, verification techniques, and test data parameters.
use_relationship:
The plan describes a series of tests to verify that cryptographic principles and protective alarms embodied in equipment agree with those stipulated in the contract. It describes the Information Assurance (IA) circuitry and functions incorporated, outlines the proposed verification techniques and procedures to be employed, and identifies the test data parameters to be measured.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to systems and equipment acquisitions involving cryptographic capabilities.

This DID is related to: DI-QCIC-81690, Security Verification Report; and the Tailored Security Design and Analysis Requirements Specification supplied with the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall be in contractor's format with the following exceptions:

children.title: Page size
children.content: The size of each finished page shall be on 8 1/2" x 11" paper (metric size A4). Drawing and illustration fold-outs may be used, but must not exceed the 8 1/2" x 11" limits when folded. Photo-reduction of oversized pages is preferred, provided such reductions are easily readable and reproducible.

children.title: Binding
children.content: The plan shall be bound in such a manner that pages can be removed without damage or mutilation.

children.title: Change/revision identification
children.content: Changes shall be by replacement change pages with revision changes and additions from earlier versions being identified by a solid vertical bar and applicable revision number/letter on the outside page margin. Revision deletions shall be identified by an asterisk and revision code in the outside margin.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain front matter and four sections as follows:

children.title: Cover and Title Page
children.content: The following information shall be included on the cover and Title page:

children.title: Plan and Procedures date of issue
Plan and Procedures document number/revision number or letter
Program title, including program name and Telecommunications Security (TSEC) Joint Electronic Type Designation (JETDS) number as applicable
Revision Control Page
children.content: The revision control page shall list the following information:

children.title: Table of Contents
children.content: The table of contents shall identify the following:

children.title: The title and starting page of each major section and paragraph of the plan
The page, identifying number, and title of each drawing, illustration, figure, and table
Section I, Functional description
children.content: The functional description includes a detailed description of critical Information Assurance (IA) circuitry using flow charts, networks, and narrative as appropriate to depict time-referenced signals. The descriptions shall address, as a minimum, the following listed functions, and any others specified in the Functional Security Requirements Specification supplied with the contract. Each description shall be in a context suitable to allow a functional computer simulation specifying as necessary, time-referenced functional signals.

children.title: Section II, Verification technique description
children.content: This section shall describe precisely each proposed test, operation, or technique, which is intended to verify the embodiment, as described, for each specified function contained in Section I. The description shall include, if appropriate:

children.title: The level of verification (chip, board, box, etc.)
Section III, Data Description
children.content: This section shall include a description of the data, type, format, and signal names to be provided as a result of the verification tests.

children.title: Section IV, Procedures
children.content: This section shall include the detailed steps of how each test will be conducted. Each step shall be limited to one simple operation. The procedures should be detailed enough so that a person who is familiar with the test equipment could easily perform the test with these procedures.
